prompt:
Night scene with black sky. Render the main tree as a bright white silhouette with subtle backlit fog; layer false-color red vegetation near the ground and mid bushes (not the canopy); an optional white horse form may emerge from the haze, sculpted and photographic, not a drawing. No neon, no line-art, no posterization; single photographic exposure with realistic light falloff and fine film grain. Keep perspective and shadows coherent; avoid overlays or duplicated patterns.
[Guidance] Use the provided images as references with an image-to-image transformation strength ≈ 0.42 (0=loose, 1=strict).
